 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 02-09-2025 No one appears on behalf of the petitioner though State is present.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the grant of following relief(s):
"for direction to the respondents to pay in total to the extent of Rs. 60,00,000.00/-
the compensation of land and of three storage building's part portion demolished measuring 60 Sq m at Keshra no. 158/198 and 17 Sq m from Kehsra no. 226/228 of the building of petitioner to make passage of six way lane of NH2 at Pali Road at Dehri, including demolishing charge of Patna High Court CWJC No.19039 of 2016(2)
dt.02-09-2025 three storage building, wastage of 18 windows and doors besides the value of mosaic and marble which was not added at the time of consideration of said compensation for the said land and part portion of the building of the petitioner besides enhancement of increase in rate of compensation year to year till 2014."
